cards.title: Method versus level
cards.body: IEC 61000-4-3 is the method for putting a product in a radio-frequency field. It does not pick the volts per metre. The product standard does. EN 301 489-1 is a concrete published choice for many radios: 3 V/m.

cards.title: The radio example
cards.body: Clause 9.2 runs from 80 MHz to 6 GHz at 3 V/m, measured with the carrier unmodulated. Then apply 80% AM at 1 kHz. If the wanted audio is already 1 kHz, move the immunity tone to 400 Hz so you can hear which is which.

cards.title: Steps and dwell
cards.body: Receivers and transmitters step at 1% of the frequency you are on. A 1% step at 1 GHz is 10 MHz. Stay at each step long enough for the product to exercise and to respond. A dwell shorter than the control loop is a false pass.

cards.title: Uniform field
cards.body: Ordinary IEC 61000-4-3 calibration uses a 1.5 m by 1.5 m window and 16 points. At least 12 of them sit between 0 dB and +6 dB of the target. The window is not ±6 dB. A point below the target is a miss. Both polarizations are part of the test, not only of the calibration.

cards.title: Pass rule
cards.body: This test uses the continuous criterion, not the ESD one. During the sweep the radio keeps operating as intended, does not transmit by mistake, does not change state, and does not change critical stored data. A dropped link is not excused by the transient wording.

cards.title: Exclusion band
cards.body: The notch keeps the test off the radio's own channel. For a channelized transmitter it is 250% of the channel width each side of centre. It is not used in standby. Receiver emission scans do not get an exclusion band at all.

cards.title: The wanted signal
cards.body: The threat and the link are different generators. The wanted receive signal is at most 40 dB above the minimum usable level, checked with the immunity amplifiers on but not driven. The transmitter under test runs at maximum rated power.

cards.title: Watch it from outside
cards.body: Monitors and signal sources stay outside the field. An integral antenna uses a link antenna in the room and a cable the field does not ride. A display with no port is watched by a camera or a non-conductive tube, not by a wire draped into the window.

cards.title: Usual failures
cards.body: Modulation left off. One polarization. Dwell shorter than the product. Product outside the calibrated window. Amplifier in compression. Wanted signal cranked far past 40 dB. A handheld sniff treated as a 3 V/m pass. Record frequency, level, modulation, and polarization when something falls over.

cards.title: The other band, and the preview
cards.body: 150 kHz to 80 MHz at 3 V rms is conducted RF on cables, clause 9.5, not this field. The CISPR 14-2 preview says appliance radiated immunity was extended above 1 GHz. It does not print those levels. Do not invent them.
cards.citation: ETSI EN 301 489-1 V2.2.3, clause 9.5; EN IEC 55014-2:2021 preview
